details.proposal_title: Maple Street Backyard Workshop – Construction Proposal
details.proposal_notes:
This proposal covers the estimated materials and planned labor for a detached 20 ft × 24 ft backyard workshop at 1842 Maple Street, Marietta, Georgia.

Scope includes site preparation, concrete footing/slab work, framing, roof sheathing, asphalt shingles, wall insulation, drywall, and interior paint as shown in the estimate.

Final layout, header sizing, structural connections, permits, electrical work, plumbing, HVAC, utility connections, grading beyond the immediate work area, and any plan-required engineering are excluded unless specifically added in writing.

Material pricing is based on supplier pricing available when this proposal was prepared and may change if work is not authorized promptly. Any work outside this scope requires written approval through a change order.

Thank you for the opportunity to provide this proposal.
